new_findings.summary: Visible VLS V1.0 tables print ListAllLiveStreamsData as -1:* and CameraCurrentState/VideoCodec as -1:1. These are not valid ordinary cardinality notation; the intended replacement values are not guessed.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: none for V1.0 strict XML because no exact official V1.0 VideoLiveService XSD is confirmed; do not synthesize cardinalities

existing_finding_updates.effect: Confirmed by recursive tree inspection of the official upstream VDV-301-1.0 tag and its monolithic IBIS_IP_V1.0.xsd: no VideoLiveService V1.0 service XSD, include or declaration is present. V1.0 must not be routed through V2.0.

Fresh byte-pinned VLS V1.0 visual evidence independently confirms LiveStreamData is documented as one multi-field stream record. This strengthens semantic history only; the executable mismatch remains scoped to the official V2.0 XSD and EV-103.
Visually confirmed from the exact pinned source on page 4 using fallback render run 33202961159: German foreword says VDV 301-2-1 while the English foreword says VDV 301-2-11.
